recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-15562 unless a broader editorial pass independently revisits the Patient MPI narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-15562 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the Patient resource asking that the last paragraph of section 8.1.10, Patient Matching using an MPI, change the misspelled word "insuffience" to "insufficient" in the sentence about MPIs not returning data when search parameter data is insufficient.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in git commit ecc5ae645455764695b421d848c4e5f9258a3ea2, "GF#15562: Typo in patient-notes.xml", which changed the exact reported "insuffience" text but left an intermediate misspelling, "insuffient". A later Patient QA commit, 026e3a7587d4b6f197ad306083aea467d6400c74, changed that sentence to the currently correct "insufficient search parameter data" wording.
additional_context: The current Patient narrative source is in build scope because source/fhir.ini has an active [resources] entry patient=Patient. Searches for the issue key and MPI typo terms found no Zulip or Confluence discussion that changes the Jira/source conclusion, and Jira phrase searches returned only FHIR-15562.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/patient/patient-notes.xml already says "Often MPIs won't return data if there is insufficient search parameter data, such as a partial surname," so the requested typo correction is present in the current build source.
